name: Household altar or shrine
definition: cabinet, shelf or box shrine kept in a home or room to hold sacred images, name tablets or talismans; style (modern, karaki, gold-leaf), wall-hung installation and compact or mini size are attributes.
notes: Butsudan in modern, karaki, gold, wall-hung, compact styles; kamidana by roof type

name: Shrine boundary rope
definition: rope hung to mark a sacred space or object in a rite (shimenawa a named form); a seasonal festival decoration such as the kadomatsu is B4.
notes: Shop menu lists shimenawa (shrine rope) as its own category

name: Devotional panel painting
definition: sacred picture painted on a rigid panel, framed or mounted to stand or hang (icon a named form).
notes: Byzantine icon painted on wood with frame

name: Devotional scroll painting
definition: sacred picture painted or printed on cloth or paper and mounted as a hanging scroll or rolled for hanging (thangka, kakejiku honzon scroll, pata).
notes: Hand-painted thangka on cotton canvas; kakejiku hanging-scroll honzon category

name: Altarpiece
definition: large sacred picture or carved screen made to stand behind or above an altar, old-master altarpieces included (K-108).
notes: Museum record: carved Antwerp retable made for devotion, supplied off the shelf by workshops

name: Devotional statue
definition: sculpted figure of a holy person, deity or saint made to be venerated; the figure is an iconography tag, not a kind.
notes: Christ, Blessed Virgin Mary and saint statues sold as categories

name: Devotional cross
definition: cross, with or without a figure on it, made to stand, hang or be held in veneration (crucifix a named form).
notes: Crucifix collection; church shop Kreuze category

name: Nativity set
definition: boxed or composed set of figures and a stable showing the birth of Jesus, sold and compared as one set (K-1).
notes: Ivory & Gold Nativity Set 11 pieces; stable with Holy Family figures sold as a set

name: Relic
definition: body part or belonging of a holy person, or a thing touched to one, kept for veneration; `relic_class` (first, second, third) is a classification attribute.
notes: Listing: reliquary with first-class relic; relic given free, container sold

name: Reliquary
definition: case or container made to hold and show a relic.
notes: Reliquiare category; silver reliquary listing

name: Prayer beads
definition: string or loop of beads, knots or counters made to count prayers, with or without a cross, counter, tassel or guru bead (rosary, chaplet, tasbih, mala, juzu named forms); a necklace of the same beads made as jewellery is A3 (K-111).
notes: Rosaries, tasbih (by order and material) and juzu sold

name: Prayer rug
definition: rug or mat made to kneel, stand or prostrate on in prayer; `padding`, `non_slip_base` and `surface_fabric` are attributes, travel and children's are setting and user tags; a meditation cushion or mat is B2 (K-113).
notes: Prayer rugs: kids, large, thin, travel

name: Prayer wheel
definition: cylinder holding written prayers, turned by hand, wind or water.
notes: Handheld Prayer Wheel, Mani Wheel product

name: Prayer flag
definition: cloth flag printed with prayers or sacred images, hung to be blown by the wind.
notes: Cotton prayer flags in sets of five; wholesale Tibetan prayer flags

name: Devotional medal
definition: loose medal of a saint or sacred subject made for devotion; one made with a chain or bail to be worn is A3, one struck to commemorate or reward F3 (K-107).
notes: St Benedict medal sold loose in packs of 25, antique copper

name: Prayer card
definition: printed card with a sacred image or prayer, kept or carried for devotion (K-112).
notes: Holy card with prayer on back, Fratelli Bonella

name: Holy-water font [stoup]
definition: small basin for holy water, hung or stood by a door or in a room.
notes: Holy Water Fonts collection

name: Holy-water bottle
definition: bottle or flask made to hold blessed water.
notes: Glass holy water bottle with cork, water not included

name: Carried protective charm
definition: small charm carried, not worn as jewellery, for luck, protection or a named blessing (omamori, carried evil-eye charm); worn A3, issued for money F3 (K-117).
notes: Marketplace listing of omamori from Kamakado Shrine; carried-charm use not shown on page

name: Ritual cup
definition: cup or goblet made to hold wine or another drink used in a rite (chalice, kiddush cup named forms).
notes: Kiddush cups; Kelche (chalices)

name: Monstrance
definition: display vessel with a window or frame, made to show a consecrated host.
notes: Monstranzen category

name: Ritual food plate [seder plate]
definition: plate or tray made to hold the symbolic foods of a rite; the food itself is not F4.
notes: Seder Plates for Passover, 32 products

name: Aspergillum
definition: sprinkler for holy water.
notes: Pocket Holy Water Sprinkler, stainless steel aspergillum

name: Torah pointer [yad]
definition: slim rod ending in a pointing hand, held to follow the text when reading a scroll aloud.
notes: Yad Torah pointers and stands; Torah Pointers category

name: Ritual sceptre [vajra]
definition: short sceptre held in the hand in a rite.
notes: Vajra, 11 products, and vajra and bell sets

name: Ritual knife
definition: knife or blade made to be held in a rite, not to cut (athame, boline named forms).
notes: Kartika knife, 11 products (Kartika Knife of the Dakinis)

name: Doorpost scroll case [mezuzah case]
definition: case made to hold a doorpost scroll and be fixed to a doorpost; material is an attribute.
notes: Mezuzah cases by material

name: Doorpost scroll [mezuzah scroll]
definition: handwritten parchment strip of sacred text made to be put in a case and fixed to a doorpost; `script_style` and size class (to fit the case) are attributes, the kosher grade a registry row only.
notes: Mezuzah scrolls (parchments) sold apart from cases

name: Phylacteries [tefillin]
definition: pair of small boxes holding handwritten sacred passages, with straps, made to be strapped to the arm and head in prayer.
notes: Tefillin sets, bags and accessories

name: Ritual horn [shofar]
definition: horn made to be blown in a rite.
notes: Rams horn, Yemenite and decorative shofars

name: Hand bell
definition: bell held by a handle and rung in a rite or service (altar bell, sanctus bell, ghanta named forms).
notes: Vajra and bell sets (ghanta); not a church altar bell

name: Standing bowl bell
definition: bowl-shaped bell that rests on a cushion or stand and is struck with a striker, made for a rite (rin; singing bowl only when made for a rite, otherwise E3, K-110).
notes: Brass bowl bell on cushion; page ties it to the rin; Gandhanra singing bowl

name: Slit drum
definition: hollow wooden block struck to keep rhythm in chanting (mokugyo a named form).
notes: Zenon 8-inch mokugyo wood fish for Buddhist altar, sticks separate

name: Hanukkah lamp
definition: nine-branch lamp or candle holder, eight places for the festival lights and one for the helper light.
notes: Candle, oil and electric nine-branch Hanukkah menorahs

name: Seven-branch menorah
definition: seven-branch lamp or candle holder.
notes: Limited Edition 7 Branch Sderot Menorah; 7-Branched Menorahs category

name: Oil lamp for worship
definition: lamp burning oil or ghee, made for worship (diya, butter-lamp holder named forms).
notes: Brass oil lamp diya for puja; butter lamp offering bowls

name: Eternal light [sanctuary lamp]
definition: lamp kept burning before a sanctuary or altar; electric or LED is a power attribute.
notes: Hanging sanctuary lamp for Eucharistic adoration

name: Altar candlestick
definition: candle holder made to stand on or by an altar in a rite; an open candle holder for the home is B4 (K-180).
notes: Gilded brass altar candlestick; Altarleuchter

name: Ritual candle
definition: candle made for a rite or devotion, including altar, votive, procession, Easter, grave, Yahrzeit and memorial candles (K-113); occasion is a tag, wax content and power attributes.
notes: Altar, votive, procession, Easter, grave, memorial candles

name: Advent wreath
definition: wreath with candles used to count the weeks before Christmas.
notes: Liturgical Advent kit with wreath and 3 purple 1 pink candle

name: Ritual lantern
definition: lantern made to be hung or set out in a rite or as a shrine offering (bon lantern, votive stone tōrō named forms); a garden tōrō or decorative lantern is B4, a lantern made to be carried as a light B3 (K-116, K-180).
notes: Shop menu lists bon chochin lanterns, lantern stands and Obon sets

name: Ritual incense
definition: incense made for a rite, in stick, cone, resin or church grade (senko, agarbatti named forms; a smudge bundle made for a named rite, K-115).
notes: Weihrauch in church grade; senko incense by use

name: Incense burner
definition: standing or hanging vessel for burning incense (koro, joss-stick pot, dhoop stand named forms; grave incense holders with setting tag grave).
notes: Koudate incense stands, bukhoor burner, Raeuchergefaesse

name: Swung censer
definition: incense burner hung on chains, to be swung.
notes: Thurible H 23 cm brass censer on chains by Churchware

name: Offering vessel
definition: bowl, cup or vase made to hold water, rice, tea, flowers or other offerings (rice vessel, tea cup, altar flower vase; grave flower vases with setting tag grave).
notes: Water offering bowls; hanatate flower vases

name: Tarot deck
definition: 78-card deck with major and minor suits, sold for divination; each published deck design is a maker-bound named form under its publisher; a pack sold for card play is E1 (K-109).
notes: Tarot section with Rider-Waite, Thoth, Marseille decks

name: Oracle deck
definition: deck of cards with its own set of images and messages, any number of cards, sold for divination.
notes: Oracle section, e.g. Faeries Oracle

name: Lenormand deck
definition: 36-card deck of the Lenormand pattern, sold for divination.
notes: Blue Bird Lenormand, 36 cards, US Games Systems

name: Crystal ball
definition: sphere used for scrying.
notes: Crystal Ball with Stand, brand The mindful Frog

name: Spirit board
definition: lettered board with a pointer, made for divination; made as a board game it is E1 (K-114).
notes: Glow in the Dark Spirit Board with planchette

name: Rune set
definition: set of stones, wood or tiles marked with runes, made for casting.
notes: Rune Set Elder Futhark, 24 runes in bone

name: I Ching coin set
definition: coins or sticks made for casting the I Ching.
notes: I Ching Complete Divination Kit with tokens, cards and book

name: Divination pendulum
definition: weight on a chain or cord, made to be dangled for divination.
notes: Radiesthesia Set with Pendulum and Dowsing Rods listed

name: Coffin or casket
definition: box that holds a body for burial or cremation; material, steel gauge, shape, sealing and biodegradable are attributes (rental casket a named form).
notes: Named coffins and caskets; Caskets category

name: Cremation urn
definition: container for cremated remains, of any capacity from a keepsake portion to a companion pair (`capacity_class`); not a worn piece of jewellery (F4-O1); pet urns carry a user tag.
notes: Keepsake to companion cremation urns

name: Scattering urn
definition: container made to release ashes on land, water or from the air.
notes: Scattering urns category

name: Urn vault
definition: outer box or liner made to hold an urn in the ground.
notes: Urn vaults category, required by many cemeteries

name: Grave marker
definition: stone or plaque set on or at a grave (tombstone, tomb slab named forms).
notes: Headstones and memorial stones categories

name: Memorial tablet
definition: tablet that stands for a dead person, inscribed with a name, kept at an altar or home (ihai a named form).
notes: Ihai memorial tablets: traditional, modern, kuridashi

name: Funeral pall
definition: cloth laid over a coffin (coffin cover a named form).

name: Burial shroud
definition: cloth or set of cloths that wrap the body.

name: Torah finial
definition: ornament fitted to the top of a scroll's rollers.

name: Coffin plate
definition: plate fixed to a coffin, naming the dead.
notes: Coffins come with an inscribed nameplate; sold as part of the coffin

name: Coffin pillow
definition: pillow made for the inside of a coffin.
notes: Coffin interior lining set includes quilted satin pillow

name: Urn appliqué or medallion
definition: plaque, appliqué or medallion made to be fixed to an urn.
notes: Brass name-plate medallion resting around neck of adult urn
